name: selection-actions
title: Selection Actions
description: A small toolbar by text the reader selects in a region, e.g. an agent's answer: Quote (SelectionQuote) and the app's own actions (SelectionAction), each handed the selection as Markdown (selectionMarkdown: bold, inline code, links, lists, headings, quotes and fenced code with its language; buttons and hidden text left out) and its range, then the selection cleared. All of them share one set of document listeners, and a change of selection renders only the region it is in. It shows for a selection with text that starts and ends in the region and not in a field: when a mouse drag ends, a frame after a keyboard or script selection, on touch once the selection has held still; above the selection, below it on a touch screen where the OS has its own menu. It takes neither focus nor the selection, follows the selection as the page scrolls and hides while it is out of view. Tab moves into it, the arrows between its buttons, Escape hides it and returns focus. Past maxLength characters it says the selection is too long instead of offering its actions. The app decides what an action does; a quote goes in the composer as a quote chip.
